en-US.title: Mila — Personal AI Stylist
en-US.subtitle: Your digital style dossier
en-US.description:
Mila is a personal AI stylist. She reads your colouring, your silhouette, and the day ahead — then styles you for it.

YOUR DIGITAL STYLE DOSSIER
A short onboarding builds a profile Mila keeps and refines: seasonal palette and undertone, body and face shape, hair, and how you like to dress. Every recommendation she makes is drawn from it — specific to you, never generic inspiration.

A LOOK FOR TODAY
Every morning, Mila composes a daily look around your colouring, your plans, and the weather where you are. You see the pieces, the palette, and the reasoning — so you know why it works before you wear it.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU WEAR IT
With your consent, Mila renders an identity-locked style sheet showing the look on you, and a portrait preview of a single piece — so nothing is a guess.

FIND THE DUPE
Photograph a piece you love, or spot one in the Feed, and the Dupe Hunter scans a vetted catalogue for close matches: real price, real seller, real shipping.

ASK MILA ANYTHING
The Concierge answers your styling questions, keeps the thread, and remembers the look you are asking about.

A COMMUNITY OF CONSIDERED DRESSERS
Share your looks in the Feed, tag the pieces in them, and find what looks like what you already own.

MEMBERSHIP
Mila is free to begin — building your style profile costs nothing. Look generation uses credits, and membership plans include a monthly allotment.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Photos are used only with your explicit consent, everything can be exported, and your account can be deleted from inside the app.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: your digital style dossier, daily looks styled to your colouring and the weather, the Dupe Hunter, and the Feed.
en-US.promoText: Meet Mila — a personal AI stylist who reads your colouring, your silhouette, and the sky outside, then dresses you for the day.
